section_header: AIR CONDITIONING SYSTEM — Functional Test and Adjustment
title: Power Servo Unit Operation

content.description: Image showing check connector location on normal condition relay

items.text: PLACE BLOWER CONTROL LEVER AT AUTO AIR FLOW CONTROL LEVER AT VENT TEMPERATURE CONTROL LEVER AT 77

content.description: Control panel diagram showing Temperature Control Lever, Air Flow Control Lever, Blower Control Lever, and Air Intake Control Lever positions

items.title: CHECK BLOWER SPEED CONTROL BY SLIDING TEMPERATURE CONTROL LEVER
subitems: (a) When sliding the lever to 70, the blower speed will change in five steps.
(b) When sliding the lever to 85, the blower speed will change in four steps.

content.description: Close-up photograph of water valve component

items.title: CHECK WATER VALVE OPERATION BY SLIDING TEMPERATURE CONTROL LEVER
subitems: (a) When placing the lever at the left side fully, the water valve will close.
(b) When placing the lever at 75 or more, the water valve will open.

content.description: Photograph showing power servo stem component

items.text: CHECK POWER SERVO STEM FOR A SMOOTH OPERATION BY SLIDING TEMPERATURE CONTROL LEVER
